content.short: Violet is a platform for managing regulatory compliance and identity.
content.description: Violet is a dApp for efficient management of identity and regulatory compliance. Supported by Argent and the Ethereum Foundation, Violet supports compliant identity workflows across Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Multichain. From a legal perspective, Violet maintains partnerships with many countries to satisfy local laws and operate accordingly. It leverages zk proofs to protect user anonymity, credentials, and activities, and relies on fluid off-chain data storage to keep user data tamper-proof.
